name: coder-delegation
description: Multi-role AI coding collaboration: strong-model Architect reuses a superpowers-produced plan + execution plan, machine-readizes into a Coder task doc, weak-model Coder executes mechanically, Architect reviews. Orchestrates serial workflow: (superpowers plan) → machine-readize → confirm → execute → self-test → review → optional multi-reviewer blind audit bridge. Architect does NOT design solutions (superpowers does).

interface.shortDescription: Strong-model machine-readizes & reviews, weak-model codes (plan from superpowers).
interface.longDescription: A multi-role coding collaboration plugin. The Architect (strong model) reuses a technical plan + execution plan produced by superpowers (brainstorming + writing-plans) — it does NOT design solutions itself. It machine-readizes the plan into a self-contained Coder task doc, optionally delegates large codebase scans to weak models (summary) to cut token cost, and reviews the output. A Coder (weak model) executes the task doc strictly, runs self-tests, and completes a self-review checklist before delivery. When changes exceed thresholds, the Architect suggests bridging to multi-reviewer for blind audit.
